title: Lazy Sunday Peruvian Samphire Gratin
description: A mustardy, flaky, lacto-vegetarian-friendly Peruvian dish featuring samphire and nuka-pickle, perfect for a lazy Sunday lunch.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the flour and whisk to combine, cooking for 1 minute.
Slowly pour in the milk, whisking constantly to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until it thickens, about 5 minutes.
Remove the sauce from the heat and stir in the grated cheese until melted.
Add the chopped nuka-pickle, Dijon mustard, salt, and black pepper to the cheese sauce and stir to combine.
Arrange the samphire in a baking dish and pour the cheese sauce over the top.
Transfer the dish to the preheated oven and bake until golden and bubbly, about 20 minutes.
